basis: Explicit dependency ownership/catalog v2, additive reporting/history, broader notice eligibility and historical preflight expand the accepted contract. Role counts do not decide classification.

verified.prior_approval: Exact prior candidate and decision intact; no r1 approval applied to r2 semantics.

recommendation: Explicit commit-scoped runtime_dependencies; before/after declared reach with each side own exclusions; separate direct/support/potential-consumer report and broaden one-post all eligibility.
limits: Declared reach only, not dynamic completeness, actual loading or receipt/refresh. V1/legacy coverage unknown. Missing historical data required for comparison fails before mutation; old publishers reject v2.
consumer_correction: Absent standalone link is not unavailable support; resolve current consuming skill to its release and read sibling support there.

instruction_advice.applicability: applicable to proposed normative authoring, notification and consumer contracts
instruction_advice.outcome: No blocking authority/loading/ownership conflict found in bounded root advisory check. Declaration ownership, causal consumer-loading reason and coverage limits are explicit.
instruction_advice.limitation: Self-advisory planning review, not independent review or implementation acceptance.

human_direction.continue: Complete active validation/handoff; no r2 approval inferred

root.owner: current root and human for actual root transfer
root.requirement: Before substantial r2 implementation make a scoped renewal or authorized replacement decision. Current large root is admitted only for compact collection; no automatic recovery/transfer/resumption route established.

supervisor.requirement: Current supervisor retention covers final r2 proposal assembly only; renew scoped capacity/configuration or authorize a fresh successor with durable findings and verified collection before implementation.

leaves.requirement: Useful discovery retention is not a future scope/configuration/selection or comparison-eligibility decision.

process_disposition: Both child and supervisor results collected; no owned process/listener outstanding. Contexts preserved inactive.
